label: Appliance Control
info:
Controls dishwasher, washing machine and air conditioner via MQTT-switched
power outlets. Optimizes for electricity price, avoids grid-import spikes
and prefers PV self-consumption (4500 Wp array).

Reuses existing configs:
  MQTT broker    mqtt_broker_config (192.168.4.221)
  InfluxDB live  influxdb_config_infra (measurement pv, field PAC)
  InfluxDB 2y    influxdb_config_infra_2y (measurement pv, field mean_PAC)

Device wiring:
  washing_machine  Zigbee2MQTT  z2m/0x70b3d52b6013d856        payload.power W
                                z2m/0x70b3d52b6013d856/set    {state:ON|OFF}
  dishwasher       Tasmota      tm/tele/OgKuGsp/SENSOR        ENERGY.Power W
                                tm/cmnd/OgKuGsp/POWER1        ON|OFF  (POWER2 = USB outlet)
  air_conditioner  Tasmota      tm/tele/OgWzKli/SENSOR        ENERGY.Power W
                                tm/cmnd/OgWzKli/POWER         ON|OFF

User API (MQTT):
  red/appliance/<name>            true  = start the appliance flow
                                  false = switch the outlet off and drop the job
                                  JSON {on?, reason?, deadline?, estimated_runtime_min?,
                                        max_defer_hours?, max_power_w?}
                                        = start, or stop when on is false, with per-request
                                        overrides; reason replaces the one in the status message
  home/appliance/<name>/status    retained JSON {state, scheduled_at, runtime_min, reason, ...}

Name must be one of: washing_machine, dishwasher, air_conditioner.

Per-appliance defaults (runtime_min, max_defer_hours, max_power_w) live in
`ac_init_fn` under cfg.appliances.<name>. Any field in the start payload
overrides the default. If deadline is omitted it is derived from
`requested_at + max_defer_hours + runtime_min`.

The air conditioner is not started by hand: `ac_thermostat` polls every minute
and issues the same start/stop commands from the inside temperature
(global `weather.eco_in`, file store) and the live PV power (global `ess.pac`).
It gives up on cooling while the outside temperature (`weather.temp`) is low enough
to air out instead.
Thresholds live in cfg.ac_thermostat.
Switching it off by hand blocks automatic starts until the next day.
  red/appliance/air_conditioner/config   {temp_on_c?, temp_off_c?} | <number> = temp_on_c | default
                                  = change the thermostat temperatures at runtime

An appliance that never draws power after its outlet was switched on is given
up on after cfg.startup_timeout_min and the outlet goes off again.

NOTE: Tasmota's default TelePeriod (300s) is too slow for responsive
startup detection. Set TelePeriod to ~10s on OgKuGsp and OgWzKli, or the
scheduler won't see the first power spike for up to five minutes.

name: === Changelog ===
info:
v0.1  2026-04-13  Initial flow: MQTT start API, per-device power monitor, scheduler with hourly PV curve + price forecast, defer/retry, Influx 30s poll for live PV.
v0.2  2026-04-14  Removed 30s Influx PV poll; live PV now read from global `ess.pac` (shared with battery controller).
v0.3  2026-04-14  Scheduler rewritten to evaluate candidate starts on a 15-min grid and integrate cost/spike check across the full runtime, matching battery controller v2 slot convention.
v0.4  2026-04-14  Added this changelog comment node.
v0.5  2026-04-14  Job state moved from flow-scoped `devices` to `global.jobs`, so other flows can read appliance scheduling state.
v0.6  2026-04-14  Added in-flow test cases (T1-T4): inject buttons + setup function nodes that exercise ac_scheduler in `_test` mode (no MQTT/state side effects), results to debug sidebar.
v0.7  2026-04-14  Per-appliance defaults for runtime_min, max_defer_hours, max_power_w in cfg.appliances; start payload fields are now optional and override the defaults; deadline is derived when absent.
v0.8  2026-04-14  Completed jobs are retained in `global.jobs` under archive keys `<name>#<completed_at>` for 7 days; pruned on each completion and on new start. Active jobs remain keyed by bare name.
v0.9  2026-04-15  Added in-flow test T5: end-to-end appliance run simulation (start→startup→scheduler→running→completion) with a mock clock and no side effects.
v0.10 2026-08-12  Air conditioner runs on a thermostat: `weather.eco_in` >= 27 starts it, < 26 stops it, PV below 1200 W blocks a start and (after a 5 min dwell) stops a run. AC defer window cut to 1 h; start/stop commands carry a reason so the voice message says why.
v0.11 2026-08-12  Turning the air conditioner off by hand (stop command, plug button or its own remote) blocks thermostat starts for the rest of the calendar day.
v0.12 2026-08-12  Startup watchdog: an outlet whose appliance never draws power is switched off again after cfg.startup_timeout_min (AC 15 min, others 30) and the job dropped; for the AC that also blocks the day. AC thermostat temperatures are settable at runtime on red/appliance/air_conditioner/config and persist in the file context store.
v0.13 2026-08-12  AC thermostat also stops, and holds off starting, while the outside temperature (weather.temp) is at or below cfg.ac_thermostat.temp_outside_off_c (25 C, +0.5 K margin before it may start again); the spoken message names the outside temperature. The threshold is settable on the config topic.
v0.14 2026-08-12  The startup watchdog only cuts an outlet when it has actually received power readings that stayed below startup_w. If the meter said nothing at all it warns once (status reason no_telemetry) and leaves the outlet on - a silent plug is not proof that the appliance is idle.

=== Air conditioner thermostat ===
info:
Runs the AC from `weather.eco_in` (inside temperature) and the live PV power in `ess.pac`.
On at >= temp_on_c, off below temp_off_c, and never on below pv_min_w - a sustained PV dip also stops a running unit.
Commands go through `handle command`, so the scheduler, power monitor and voice announcements stay in charge of the rest.
Turning the AC off by hand - stop command, plug button, or its own remote - blocks automatic starts for the rest of that calendar day (`ac_manual_off_day`, file store). A manual start still works, and a stop this node issued itself does not count.

Temperatures are settable at runtime on `red/appliance/air_conditioner/config`: a JSON object {temp_on_c, temp_off_c}, a bare number for temp_on_c alone, or `default` to drop back to cfg.ac_thermostat. Overrides live in `ac_thermostat_cfg` (file store). The two inject buttons send the same thing by hand - edit the JSON in the first one to try other values.
`startup watchdog` only acts on what the meter reported: if no reading arrived at all it
warns once (`no_telemetry`) and leaves the outlet alone, since a silent plug is no proof
that the appliance is idle. It cuts an outlet whose appliance measurably never drew power within cfg.startup_timeout_min (15 min for the AC, 30 for the rest) - for the AC that also blocks the day, since nothing would stop the thermostat from asking again a minute later.
